devices/reverse/no adb.why: the adb reverse of the driver's port now covers emulators too and answers the serials it reversed (none without adb), so status can say which devices can reach the port.

devices/reverse/phones only.why: every adb device and emulator gets `adb reverse` of the driver's port, not only phones: an emulator whose 10.0.2.2 is blocked attached to nothing until it was reversed by hand.
